name: Pacific Beach Fish Shop
menu_notes: Checked against official site thefishshops.com/pacific-beach/ (source_url menutoeat.com is stale). Fish N' Chips, Ahi Poke, Crab Cake, Salmon, Seaweed Salad, Macaroni Salad matched within $1. Fish Shop Shrimp ($21.75 vs real $14.75), Coconut Shrimp ($21.75 vs $12.50) and all four tacos ($17.75 vs real $7.75-$8.00) are inflated by roughly $10-14. 'Price by Style' section stores one price per fish (e.g. Yellowtail $30.00) even though the real menu has 4 different prices per format (taco/sandwich/salad/plate, e.g. Yellowtail taco $7.25 to plate $22.00) - a structural extraction mismatch, not just drift.
data_notes: Address (1775 Garnet Ave), neighborhood (Pacific Beach), and cuisine (Seafood) all correct; lat/lng (32.8004,-117.2373) sit in Pacific Beach. Hours are off by 30 min on 4 of 7 days: real is Sun-Wed 11am-9:30pm / Thu-Sat 11am-10pm, but our data has all 7 days closing at 10pm. Restaurant is open and operating.
issues: 'River Halibut' is not a real menu item/fish option (garbled name)
'Halibut' (Local Catch section) is not among the current fish options at all
Taco prices in 'Fish Shop Favorites' are ~$10 too high vs current menu
'Price by Style' dishes carry a single flat price instead of the real taco/sandwich/salad/plate tiers, and several don't match any real tier
Hours wrong for Sun/Mon/Tue/Wed (should close 9:30pm, data says 10pm)
